alt.en: Logits ln 2, zero, zero become weights 2, 1, 1 and probabilities one half, one quarter, one quarter. Targets Paris and Lyon have losses ln 2 and ln 4; their mean is ln 8 divided by 2 and perplexity is square root 8.
alt.zh-hans: 分数 ln 2、0、0 变成权重 2、1、1，再变成概率二分之一、四分之一、四分之一。目标为巴黎和里昂时，损失分别为 ln 2 和 ln 4；平均损失为 ln 8 除以 2，困惑度为根号 8。

caption.en: Figure 6.1 — Candidate normalization and target averaging use different denominators.
caption.zh-hans: 图 6.1 — 候选概率的归一化与目标损失的平均，使用不同的分母。

label.en: One prediction; candidate order Paris, Lyon, other
label.zh-hans: 一次预测；候选顺序为巴黎、里昂、其他

flow.en: Divide each weight by the sum of all three candidate weights.
flow.zh-hans: 每项权重都除以三个候选权重的总和。

label.en: Two labeled predictions with that same distribution
label.zh-hans: 两个有目标标注的预测，使用相同分布

flow.en: Divide total loss by two scored targets, not by three candidates or padded storage slots.
flow.zh-hans: 总损失除以两个计分目标，不是除以三个候选，也不是除以含补齐项的槽位数。
